content.short: Monethic.io delivers cybersecurity services for Web3, including smart contract and DeFi audits, penetration tests, and security reviews.
content.description: Monethic.io is a security services company founded by security engineers. It offers a range of cybersecurity services to protect web3 and web2 assets, including smart contract and DeFi audits, penetration testing, and security reviews. Backed by a team of experienced professionals, Monethic delivers top-quality protection across engagements, ensuring robust safeguards for businesses operating in blockchain environments.
